versions.changelog: La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release: Automated generation of 15–25 cinematic B-roll clips for VSLs using Higgsfield.

- Generates B-roll clip catalogs for long-form scripts (>5 min), prioritizing 80% avatar-based shots (with user reference photo) and 20% cinematic abstract shots.
- Automatically handles scene count, visual style (cyberpunk/corporate/etc.), and workflow through guided questions if not specified.
- Integrates with Higgsfield Seedance 2.0 and Cinema Studio 3.0 (when available), including upload and download management.
- Final output: complete B-roll catalog with video URLs and exact script lines for insertion.
- Only activates for valid B-roll requests on long scripts; routes short video/image requests to other skills.
